entries.title: Job 15:1
segments: ¶Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

entries.title: Job 15:2
segments: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind? {vain...: Heb. knowledge of wind}

entries.title: Job 15:3
segments: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

words.text: wherewith he can do no good

entries.title: Job 15:4
segments: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God. {castest...: Heb. makest void} {prayer: or, speech}

entries.title: Job 15:5
segments: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty. {uttereth: Heb. teacheth}

entries.title: Job 15:6
segments: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

words.text: thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips

entries.title: Job 15:7
segments: [Art] thou the first man [that] was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

entries.title: Job 15:8
segments: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

entries.title: Job 15:9
segments: What knowest thou, that we know not? [what] understandest thou, which [is] not in us?

entries.title: Job 15:10
segments: With us [are] both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

entries.title: Job 15:11
segments: [Are] the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

words.text: with thee? is there any secret

entries.title: Job 15:12
segments: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

entries.title: Job 15:13
segments: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest [such] words go out of thy mouth?

entries.title: Job 15:14
segments: What [is] man, that he should be clean? and [he which is] born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

entries.title: Job 15:15
segments: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

entries.title: Job 15:16
segments: How much more abominable and filthy [is] man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

entries.title: Job 15:17
segments: ¶I will shew thee, hear me; and that [which] I have seen I will declare;

words.text: me; and that [which] I have seen

entries.title: Job 15:18
segments: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid [it]:

entries.title: Job 15:19
segments: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

entries.title: Job 15:20
segments: The wicked man travaileth with pain all [his] days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

entries.title: Job 15:21
segments: A dreadful sound [is] in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him. {A dreadful...: Heb. A sound of fears}

words.text: upon him. {A dreadful...: Heb. A sound of fears}

entries.title: Job 15:22
segments: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

entries.title: Job 15:23
segments: He wandereth abroad for bread, [saying], Where [is it]? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

entries.title: Job 15:24
segments: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

entries.title: Job 15:25
segments: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 15:26
segments: He runneth upon him, [even] on [his] neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

entries.title: Job 15:27
segments: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on [his] flanks.

entries.title: Job 15:28
segments: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, [and] in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

entries.title: Job 15:29
segments: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

entries.title: Job 15:30
segments: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

entries.title: Job 15:31
segments: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

words.text: Let not him that is deceived

entries.title: Job 15:32
segments: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green. {accomplished: or, cut off}

entries.title: Job 15:33
segments: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

entries.title: Job 15:34
segments: For the congregation of hypocrites [shall be] desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

entries.title: Job 15:35
segments: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit. {vanity: or, iniquity}
